propositions: test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist worksteal due to process-global logger level leak from reconciler entrypoint
rebar_reconciler root logger level is set to WARNING by install_stderr_handler and never restored, poisoning subsequent tests in the same worker
caplog.at_level(INFO) without logger argument only raises ROOT level, allowing INFO records from rebar_reconciler to be dropped at source by isEnabledFor before reaching caplog handler
existing log integrity guard in tests/conftest.py covers only rebar root logger, not the sibling rebar_reconciler root documented in src/rebar/_logging.py
fix requires generalizing REBAR_LOGGER_NAME scalar to SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES tuple and updating current_level and restore_level primitives to handle multiple roots
test demonstrating per-item WARNING is captured but pass-summary INFO is missing proves declined count is truthful (store not None) and confirms log level leak mechanism not storeless path
